In retrospective review of the frozen section of Part F,. intraoperatively diagnosed as 'atypical focus cells surrounded by chronic inflammation - focus disappears on deeper. frozen sections', most likely represents a focus of granulomatous inflammation. This mass lesion is 1.5 cm away from anterior bone margin, 0.2 cm away. from medial soft tissue margin and 0.1 cm away from lateral soft tissue margin. This mass lesion is also abutting the. submandibular gland. The cut surface of this mass lesion is white and firm. The attached submandibular gland. measures 3.2 x 2.2 x 2.0 cm. This nodular lesion within the submandibular gland is 2 cm away from the. main mass lesion. Grossly the main mass lesion is also surrounding the mandibular body. No other lesions are. present.
